title: Python: Regex Basics
description: Write a Python program that uses regular expressions to search, match, and extract patterns from text.

codeTemplate.py:
import re

text = "Contact us at support@example.com or sales@example.org. Call (555) 123-4567."

emails = re.findall(r'[\w.]+@[\w.]+', text)
print(f"Emails: {emails}")

phone = re.search(r'\(\d{3}\) \d{3}-\d{4}', text)
if phone:
    print(f"Phone: {phone.group()}")

words_with_a = re.findall(r'\b\w*a\w*\b', text.lower())
print(f"Words containing 'a': {words_with_a}")

clean = re.sub(r'[^\w\s@.]', '', text)
print(f"Cleaned: {clean}")

hints: Use `re.findall()` to find all matches of a pattern
Use `re.search()` to find the first match
